name: 2_configs
description: Consolidator + deriver: produces every build-{container}.json and cloud-data-*.json from raw inputs (a_solutions build.json, config.json, vault, home-manager). Engine migrated from cloud-data repo.

deploy.note: Outputs stay in dist/; consumers read via symlinks from a_solutions/*/src/build-{container}.json.

policy._doc: Tier-3 bind allowlist enforced by 2_configs/src/engines/test-bind-host-policy.sh and 1_workflows/src/test/test_bind_host_policy.sh. Service+container pairs that may legitimately bind 0.0.0.0 (or any non-WG interface). Everything else MUST bind the VM wg0 IP (default = vm.wg_ip resolved from cloud-data). Adding a new public binding requires a paired audit-trail comment in this allowlist; never silence the test.

public_bindings_allowlist.comment: WG mesh hub — public UDP listener
WG-over-WebSocket tunnel — restricted to localhost upstream

policy._grandfathered_doc: Pre-existing services that bind 0.0.0.0 today and will be migrated by parallel slot 3 work (SSH listen → wg_ip, IMAPS → wg_ip + caddy-l4, etc.). Each entry MUST include a tracking ref + planned-removal note. The deriver only WARNS for grandfathered entries; the strict mode (FAIL) activates once slot 3 lands.

grandfathered_violations.comment: SSH listen 0.0.0.0 — slot 3 plans wg_ip restriction
flake.nix exposes 0.0.0.0 for IMAPS/SMTPS — slot 3 plans caddy-l4 SNI mux migration
